company.name: XPAY
company.shortDescription: XPAY offers online payment solutions with a focus on simplicity and security, supporting multiple payment methods.
company.description: XPAY specializes in providing online payment solutions, focusing on simplifying and securing the process of financial transactions for businesses. It offers a platform that enables companies to manage and accept payments through a unified dashboard, facilitating a range of payment methods including account and wallet payments. XPAY's services are designed to streamline the payment process, offering features such as payment links for easy transactions and support for various payment systems like ApplePay and GooglePay. Additionally, XPAY aims to assist businesses in reducing transaction fees by offering cost-effective pricing models, including a low per-authorization fee.
